verdict.rationale: Jira's own feature docs say it connects cross-team initiatives, prioritizes high-impact work, keeps status up to date, and offers customizable fields and workflows. That covers initiative tracking with status and priority at a marketing level. An owning-team attribute on initiatives is never explicitly documented; only generic "ownership" and assigning work to a person are mentioned. Missing for 10: explicit initiative issue type/hierarchy documentation, a documented owning-team field, in-depth docs on status/priority fields, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can track initiatives with status, priority, and an owning team

citations.quote: Connect engineering, product, and marketing initiatives to coordinate big launches across every team.
